limits: This is a headless generated-DXF importer test, not a native GUI, DWG-to-DXF handoff, producer-semantic, Linux, Windows, or full FreeCAD-suite qualification.

Nonplanar faces, hidden edges, smoothing, mixed styles and other unsupported profiles remain refused or unqualified. The local twenty-patch candidate remains uncommitted and requires contributor review under FreeCAD policy.
No drawings, third-party source or binaries were added to the repository.
